topPick.thesis: Allstate (ALL) is trading at 5.9x P/E, a 63% discount to its sector average of 15.7x; RSI at 58 reflects healthy bullish momentum without overextension. Three-month price momentum of +23.7% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +338% year-on-year, underpinned by a bullish MACD crossover confirming upward price pressure. Composite score of 78/100 places ALL in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +13.7% over the past quarter.
